Subject: Demo request: benchmark report download

Hi Marissa,

I just downloaded the "2026 LLM inference benchmark" from your site (great report, thanks) and wanted to see if we could schedule a short demo. We're evaluating inference vendors to reduce per-token cost and get consistent latency for our 2k-4k token conversational workloads.

A few quick details about us: Acme Analytics (series B), product team of 8, real-time conversational analytics use case. We care about p95 latency and predictable unit economics. Would love a 30-minute walkthrough focused on runtime, quantization options, and routing/cost controls.

Available windows this week: Wed 7/29 after 11am PT, Thu 7/30 morning. If you have a recording or short notes I can read ahead, that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager
Acme Analytics
alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com
(415) 555-0123
